items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Louis Bellson and Charlie Shavers co-led a combo in Moline... Louis Bellson, Buddy de Franco, Charlie Shavers, Hank Jones and myself.

ctx.x: After City College in '47-'48, '49, isn't that when you started working with Errol Garner?
Yeah, but I went back to New York in '48 and had another collision (Laughter). Tommy Dorsey went on vacation, so Louis Bellson and Charlie Shavers co-led a combo in Moline.
